hints.title: Associative Property Mapping
hints.text: Pair corresponding indices from two collections into a consolidated structure while keeping the earliest occurrence of duplicate entries.

hints.title: String Coercion and Membership Checking
hints.text: Coerce each primary entry to string representation and verify whether the property has already been registered in the target dictionary.

hints.title: Linear Iteration Blueprint
hints.text: Iterate from index zero to length minus one. If key is not in result, assign result[key] = valuesArr[i].

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Single linear scan with constant-time dictionary lookups.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Assigning unconditionally overwrites previous values when duplicate keys appear.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Allocates storage for unique keys and values.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Handling key coercion via String(k) and first-occurrence preservation via the "in" operator.
